## When ARGUS suggests it

Headache is ticked in the symptom checklist and the cabin CO₂ 7-day average is 2.5 mmHg or more [SRC_NASA_CO2_PAGE].

## Steps

1. Check the CO₂ panel. [SRC_NASA_CO2_PAGE]
2. Ventilate the sleep station or improve airflow. [demo wording]
3. Hydrate. [demo wording]
4. Re-check in 1 hour. [demo wording]
5. Send a report to the flight surgeon. [demo wording]
